newsitem.title: UK: Helical Bar buys London office property.
newsitem.headline: Helical Bar buys London office property.

text.p: Property investment and developement group Helical Bar Plc said on Tuesday it had purchased a portfolio of seven central London office properties from a private vendor for 80 million stg.
The properties generate a current net income of 6.2 millio stg per annum, rising to an estimated 7.3 million stg per annum, the company said in a statement.
Tenants on long leases include Shell Transport and Trading Plc, Ernst & Young and BICC PLC.

To finance this acquisition Helical has taken over existing facilities with the Norwich Union and the Portman Building Societies, as well as utilising its own facilities with Bayerische Hypotheken-und Wechsel-Bank AG, DePfa Bank and the Helaba.
